title: Being (locally) quasi-finite is fpqc local on the base

difficulty_reason: The proof first reduces the pair of properties: quasi-compactness is already known fpqc local on the base (cited earlier lemma), so it suffices to treat locally quasi-finite. Then it runs the chart-reduction: the framework lemma's assumptions hold by the cited \'etale-locality lemma; local quasi-finiteness is moved to the \'etale charts (U \to Z and Z' \times_Z U \to Z'), and the scheme-side fpqc descent lemma concludes. The reduction of quasi-finite to the local property plus quasi-compactness and the chart transport are the substance.
